pages.text: Keep wearing them: $(bold)30 s → level 1$(), $(bold)60 s → level 2$(), $(bold)90 s → level 3$() (defaults, server-configurable).$(br2)From level 2 your feet start sliding (slide retention is configurable); at level 3 green stink particles appear around your feet.

Higher levels mean: higher-level sweat bottles when pouring, and longer soak times when washing.$(br2)After level 3, $(bold)30 more seconds of wear → foot fungus$() (default 30 s, server-configurable — see the "Foot Fungus" entry).
